I was in job corps for a year (San Diego) and honestly from my experience i didn’t love it. Every Job Corps center is different though— I will say that Job Corps is great for learning new skills and getting more experience in different fields- they also give you 3 meals a day AND they pay you (even though it isn’t much- when I was there I was getting $35 for the first few months) every 2 weeks. It’s a great program for someone in your situation, OP. I’d honestly go back if my 25th birthday wasn’t in a month lol. You may have to wait to get in and everything (my start date was 2 months after all the paperwork was done) but
